spans.text: But if you would ask it of me, I cannot do anything but accept.

units.rawText: If so... don't just go off and die after leaving a singular thing! Come and tell me to my face!
units.displayText: If so... don't just go off and die after leaving a singular thing! Come and tell me to my face!

spans.text: If so... don't just go off and die after leaving a singular thing! Come and tell me to my face!

units.rawText: Tell me to live on with your own damn mouth!
units.displayText: Tell me to live on with your own damn mouth!

spans.text: Tell me to live on with your own damn mouth!

units.rawText: Lind reaches towards that bright spark, her hand pervading Knot's phantasm, tightly grasping the tentacles on the Entropic core.
units.displayText: Lind reaches towards that bright spark, her hand pervading Knot's phantasm, tightly grasping the tentacles on the Entropic core.

spans.text: Lind reaches towards that bright spark, her hand pervading Knot's phantasm, tightly grasping the tentacles on the Entropic core.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>?!</color>
Ah, seems I've failed to die again...
units.displayText: Ah, seems I've failed to die again...

spans.text: Ah, seems I've failed to die again...

units.rawText: Seriously, there's always someone stopping me from going all the way. What a pain...
units.displayText: Seriously, there's always someone stopping me from going all the way. What a pain...

spans.text: Seriously, there's always someone stopping me from going all the way. What a pain...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Why...</color>
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: Aha, you look surprised.
units.displayText: Aha, you look surprised.

spans.text: Aha, you look surprised.

units.rawText: I wanted to say this before. I hate it whenever someone gives me that kind of high-and-mighty cocky expression.
units.displayText: I wanted to say this before. I hate it whenever someone gives me that kind of high-and-mighty cocky expression.

spans.text: I wanted to say this before. I hate it whenever someone gives me that kind of high-and-mighty cocky expression.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>You should have gone unconscious already from the Entropization...</color>
units.displayText: You should have gone unconscious already from the Entropization...

spans.text: You should have gone unconscious already from the Entropization...

units.rawText: You really don't take me for anything, huh? What pain I've felt before is a million times greater than this pathetic bit of liquid!
units.displayText: You really don't take me for anything, huh? What pain I've felt before is a million times greater than this pathetic bit of liquid!

spans.text: You really don't take me for anything, huh? What pain I've felt before is a million times greater than this pathetic bit of liquid!

units.rawText: Ptolemaea instinctively tries to create distance, but Lind latches onto her tentacles and quickly comes into striking distance.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea instinctively tries to create distance, but Lind latches onto her tentacles and quickly comes into striking distance.

spans.text: Ptolemaea instinctively tries to create distance, but Lind latches onto her tentacles and quickly comes into striking distance.

units.rawText: Wanna take my operands? Then you can have them with a side of entropy liquid!
units.displayText: Wanna take my operands? Then you can have them with a side of entropy liquid!

spans.text: Wanna take my operands? Then you can have them with a side of entropy liquid!

units.rawText: Let me teach you what true pain is!
units.displayText: Let me teach you what true pain is!

spans.text: Let me teach you what true pain is!
